customManagers.description: Non-Docker tool versions in .gitea/tool-versions.env (no digest handling).
Temurin JDK tag with Docker digest pinning in .gitea/tool-versions.env.

Codex amd64 musl-package archive checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/rust-vX.Y.Z.

Codex arm64 musl-package archive checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/rust-vX.Y.Z.

yq amd64 binary checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z.

yq arm64 binary checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z.

uv amd64 tarball checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Tags are plain semver so getDigest requests releases/tags/X.Y.Z.

uv arm64 tarball checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Tags are plain semver so getDigest requests releases/tags/X.Y.Z.

promtool amd64 tarball checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z.

promtool arm64 tarball checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z.

tofu amd64 zip checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z.

tofu arm64 zip checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z.

kubeconform amd64 tarball checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z.

kubeconform arm64 tarball checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z.

kubectl amd64 binary checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release. Values stay in tag form so lookups use releases/tags/vX.Y.Z; the binary itself is fetched from dl.k8s.io, not a release attachment.

kubectl arm64 binary checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release. Values stay in tag form so lookups use releases/tags/vX.Y.Z; the binary itself is fetched from dl.k8s.io, not a release attachment.
constraints.bun must move in the same PR as BUN_VERSION, or that PR fails its own tripwire test.
